title: Outline and Structure the New README.md
description: Create a clear, navigable structure for the README.md, including a Table of Contents and all required sections.
details: Draft the Table of Contents and section headers: About This Project, Features, Tech Stack, Getting Started, API Key Management, Project Structure, Deployment, and any additional relevant sections. Ensure logical flow and easy navigation. Add badges (e.g., build status, license) at the top for quick reference. Prepare placeholders for screenshots and external documentation links.
test_strategy: Peer review the outline for completeness and clarity. Confirm all required sections are present and logically ordered.

title: Draft and Write Core README Content
description: Write detailed content for each section of the README.md, focusing on project purpose, architecture, and technology stack.
details: Populate each section with clear, concise explanations. Cover project goals, architecture patterns, technology stack, and core features (authentication, database, UI, AI integration). Use formatted code blocks for commands and configuration examples. Link to official documentation for major dependencies. Include screenshots or placeholders as needed.
test_strategy: Review for technical accuracy and completeness. Ensure all descriptions are clear and understandable to new developers.

title: Develop the 'Getting Started' and Deployment Guides
description: Create step-by-step guides for setting up, configuring, and deploying the application, including Docker and environment variables.
details: Write a detailed 'Getting Started' section covering repository cloning, environment variable setup (referencing .env.example), database initialization, and launching the app with Docker Compose. Develop a 'Deployment' section explaining production build and deployment, with emphasis on secure management of secrets and environment variables. Use imperative, actionable language and formatted code blocks.
test_strategy: Follow the written instructions from scratch to verify all steps work as described. Adjust content based on any issues encountered.

title: Document API Key & Credential Management
description: Add a comprehensive section on managing API keys and credentials for AI services, covering both application-level and user-level keys.
details: Explain the distinction between application-level API keys (set in .env) and user-provided keys (managed via UI and stored in the database). Provide security best practices, recommend secret management tools for production, and clarify how these keys integrate with the AI features. Use clear examples and highlight the importance of secure handling.
test_strategy: Peer review for clarity, technical accuracy, and completeness. Ensure the section addresses both developer and security concerns.

title: Update or Create .env.example File
description: Ensure the .env.example file is complete and matches all environment variables referenced in the README and application code.
details: Review the application code and README to identify all required environment variables (e.g., DATABASE_URL, NEXTAUTH_SECRET, AI API keys). Update or create .env.example with clear placeholder values and comments explaining each variable's purpose. Reference this file in the README setup instructions.
test_strategy: Attempt setup using only the .env.example as a template. Confirm that all necessary variables are present and correctly described.
